Items.Name: Alpha / Omega
Items.Desc: Charge shot fires a burst of five energy bolts. Each hit reduces charge time by 0.1s and increases damage by 10% for 1.5s. Stacks 5x.

Items.Name: Aphelion
Items.Desc: Fires a hypercharged wide-arching line that passes through targets.

Items.Name: AS-10 "Bulldog"
Items.Desc: A brutal drum-fed fully-automatic 10 gauge shotgun designed for close-quarters combat.

Items.Name: Blackmaw AR-47
Items.Desc: A fully automatic rifle with a medium capacity. Highly effective with controlled bursts.

Items.Name: Black Greatsword
Items.Desc: A massive weapon of pure destruction. Attacks can be enhanced by Charging at the cost of Stamina over time. Increases Encumbrance by 15.

Items.Name: Chicago Typewriter
Items.Desc: A classic Tommy Gun with large ammo capacity and a slow reload. Poor initial accuracy which improves while holding down the trigger.

Items.Name: Coach Gun
Items.Desc: A double-barrel over/under shotgun modified to fire powerful slugs. High damage with a decent fire rate, but very low magazine capacity.

Items.Name: Corrupted Aphelion
Items.Desc: A laser shotgun that fires three hypercharged arc lines that penetrate targets.

Items.Name: Corrupted Arbalest
Items.Desc: Fully automatic mechanisms launch a bouncing Energy Disc that can hit up to 2 enemies in close proximity. Damage is reduced after bouncing.

Items.Name: Corrupted Deceit
Items.Desc: A pinpoint accurate split-barreled rifle that fires two penetrating rails. High base damage, but cannot score Weakspot hits. Charge to fire.

Items.Name: Corrupted Merciless
Items.Desc: Fires high-powered nails. Limited magazine size.

Items.Name: Corrupted Savior
Items.Desc: A Black Crystal weapon which gains increased Fire Rate as Mod Power is generated. Mod power drains after 3s of not dealing damage.

Items.Name: Crescent Moon
Items.Desc:
An ethereal weapon that seems to resonate.

Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

Items.Name: Crossbow
Items.Desc: An accurate and deadly single-shot crossbow with a low sound profile.

Items.Name: Deceit
Items.Desc: A pinpoint accurate split-barreled rifle that fires two penetrating rails. High base damage, but cannot score Weakspot hits. Charge to fire.

Items.Name: Ford's Scattergun
Items.Desc: An incredibly powerful 12 gauge shotgun with a wide spread. High damage, slow reload.

Items.Name: Genesis
Items.Desc: N'Erudian tool with low energy reserves that generates energy bolts. Charging turbines generates additional projectiles. Max 5.

Items.Name: Huntmaster M1
Items.Desc: A high-powered long range bolt-action rifle with exceptional accuracy and a 2.5x magnification scope.

Items.Name: Merciless
Items.Desc: Fires tooth-like flechettes. When weapon reticle is fully compressed, flechettes apply 200 → 600 BLEED damage over 10s.

Items.Name: Monarch
Items.Desc: An once-beautiful weapon, rumored to corrupt its wielder with absolute power.

Items.Name: Monolith
Items.Desc:
Fires concentrated sand. Sustained primary fire and Sandstorm hits apply EXPOSED for 3s. Max 15s.

EXPOSED: Target receives 15% additional damage from all sources.

Items.Name: Monorail
Items.Desc: A mysterious relic that fires super-dense penetrating rails. Can be charged to unleash violent levels of energy. Warning: Overcharging may have catastrophic results.

Items.Name: Nightfall
Items.Desc: A device forged of pure evil. Fires hardened bone shards at a brisk rate dealing bonus stagger. Semi-automatic with a medium kick.

Items.Name: Plasma Cutter
Items.Desc: An energy-based cutting tool that increases damage when focused on a target. Can overheat.

Items.Name: Polygun
Items.Desc: ERROR: Unable to load description.ERROR: Unable to load description.

Items.Name: Pulse Rifle
Items.Desc: An extremely accurate, high-tech pulse rifle which shoots quick three-round bursts.

Items.Name: Repulsor
Items.Desc: Converted from experimental Dreamer tech, ideal for mid-range combat. Weapon becomes more accurate the longer AIM is held.

Items.Name: Royal Hunting Bow
Items.Desc:
A lightweight, easy handling bow designed for hunting. High critical chance, bonus damage on Weakspot hits, and a low sound profile.
Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

Items.Name: Rusty Lever Action
Items.Desc: A well-worn lever-action rifle.

Items.Name: Sagittarius
Items.Desc: A high-powered Bow which deals bonus damage to Weakspots. Can be charged for increased effect. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

Items.Name: Savior
Items.Desc: An old Fusion Rifle refactored to store and violently release energy in each shot. Can be charged for more damage. Perfect release after Charge for maximum damage.

Items.Name: Sparkfire Shotgun
Items.Desc: Fires incendiary shells that apply BURNING which deals 30 → 90 FIRE damage over 3 seconds.

Items.Name: Sporebloom
Items.Desc: An exceptionally powerful single-shot weapon that deals bonus stagger damage. Must reload after each round fired.

Items.Name: Starkiller
Items.Desc: Alien rifle that shoots high velocity rails which penetrate enemies. Equipped with a 2.5x magnification scope. Double Tap AIM to Scope.

Items.Name: Thorn
Items.Desc: Fires homing needles which deal 5 - 15 Explosive Damage after sticking for 2s. When 5  needles are stuck in a target at once, BLOWBACK triggers, dealing 50 - 150 Explosive Damage instead.

Items.Name: Twisted Arbalest
Items.Desc: A strange device which fires a bouncing Energy Disc that can hit up to 5 enemies in close proximity. Damage is reduced with each bounce.

Items.Name: Trinity Crossbow
Items.Desc: A powerful Pan crossbow designed for mid-range combat. Fires 3 bolts at a time.

Items.Name: Widowmaker
Items.Desc: A powerful single-shot sniper rifle with excellent range and pinpoint accuracy. Comes with a 3x scope. Tap SCOPE to toggle.

Items.Name: Wrangler 1860
Items.Desc: A well-rounded lever-action rifle effective at most ranges, hampered only by a slow reload.

Items.Name: XMG57 "Bonesaw"
Items.Desc: An experimental infantry support weapon used for prolonged suppressive fire. High capacity, long reload, and prone to overheating. Becomes more accurate while holding down the trigger.

Items.Name: Abyssal Hook
Items.Desc: A hammer-like anchor that swings with an exceptionally irregular ferocity.

Items.Name: Assassin's Dagger
Items.Desc: Lightweight. Silent. Deadly. It's rumored that the blade is meant to bestow a slow, agonizing death.

Items.Name: Atom Smasher
Items.Desc: A powerful crushing device that harnesses rocket technology to increase smashing force.

Items.Name: Atom Splitter
Items.Desc: A giant tool for splitting heavy rocks.

Items.Name: Blade of Gul
Items.Desc: A short, but thick sword, used by Gul Warriors. Its compact design makes for swift yet hard-hitting blows. An excellent close-range option.

Items.Name: Bone Chopper
Items.Desc: A razor-sharp hand axe. Excellent for separating flesh from bone. Charge for double attacks.

Items.Name: Crystal Staff
Items.Desc: The staff hums with energy. A destructive power within yearns to be released.

Items.Name: Decayed Claws
Items.Desc: Makeshift claws fashioned from decayed root and rusted metal.

Items.Name: Dark Matter Gauntlets
Items.Desc: The gauntlets harness the power of a neutron star and a black hole. When merged, cosmic forces are unleashed.

Items.Name: Dreamcatcher
Items.Desc: A magical stave capable of harnessing the energy of nearby enemies.

Items.Name: Edge of the Forest
Items.Desc: An elegant, yet light blade, designed to bring beauty to bloodshed. Unstoppable in the hands of a master swordsman.

Items.Name: Feral Judgement
Items.Desc: A pair of gauntlets with sharp bone blades that strike with vicious speed and velocity.

Items.Name: Gas Giant
Items.Desc: Dealing damage unleashes the dormant Toxic Gas within the head. When infused, Basic Attacks apply CORRODED for 5s.

Items.Name: Godsplitter
Items.Desc: An expertly balanced blade that is the product of advanced Fae metallurgy. Cannot score Weakspot hits without its Mod behavior.

Items.Name: Harvester Scythe
Items.Desc: Harvester automaton limb fitted with a plasma torch. The system breach of a Drzyr phantom initiated jettisoned protocols, trapping strange properties within the makeshift weapon.

Items.Name: Hero's Sword
Items.Desc: An ancient, quick, and versatile blade suited for many situations. Contains a hidden power.

Items.Name: Huntress Spear
Items.Desc: A battle-worn spear worthy of the finest hunters. Charge Melee Attacks apply CORROSION dealing 100 ACID damage over 5s.
Items.Where: Losomn · Streets of Losomn · Briella's Garden

Items.Name: Iron Greatsword
Items.Desc: A giant broadsword made from flattened railroad tracks. Dozens of ridges cut in the side for causing irreparable damage.

Items.Name: Knuckle Dusters
Items.Desc: Steel knuckles with rusty sawblade tips, designed to boost Unarmed damage.

Items.Name: Krell Axe
Items.Desc: Infused with Krell Shock magic, can be thrown if the wielder has stamina. Axe will magically reappear in hand. Charge to throw.

Items.Name: Labyrinth Staff
Items.Desc: Basic Strikes generate 10% additional Mod Power. Charge Attacks perform an AOE which strikes all enemies within 2m, dealing 75 Damage. AOE Damage generates 50% additional Mod Power.

Items.Name: Mirage
Items.Desc: The mace whirs as if living harmonics hold its shape. When swung, a breath of sand tethers to the rock crown for extended reach and lethal momentum.

Items.Name: Nightshade
Items.Desc: Fast striking claws with a high Critical Hit chance. Neutral Dodge grants the power of Lifesteal.

Items.Name: Ornate Blade
Items.Desc: An intricately-forged elongated sword. Designed to keep stronger enemies at bay, while remaining light enough for agile maneuvers.

Items.Name: Ornate Flail
Items.Desc: An intricately-forged flail with uniquely designed airways. Allows smaller wielders to get the weapon up to speed much quicker.
Items.Where: Losomn · Fae Palace · As Above, So Below

Items.Name: Rebellion Spear
Items.Desc: A spear perfect for staying at a distance. Has excellent range, great recovery, and focused direct damage for one on one combat.

Items.Name: Red Doe Staff
Items.Desc: A magical stave rumored to contain a healing spirit within. Strikes with wide swings.

Items.Name: Ritualist Scythe
Items.Desc: An evil-fueled reaping tool that deals additional damage to suffering targets.

Items.Name: Royal Broadsword
Items.Desc: Standard issue Greatsword for the Empress' Royal Guards. Razor-sharp edges, extremely heavy, yet perfectly balanced.

Items.Name: Rusted Claws
Items.Desc: A pair of old-canine training bracers converted into deadly claws. Used for slashing and ripping.

Items.Name: Scrap Hammer
Items.Desc: A large, heavy warhammer cobbled together from engine components. It is a slow-but-devastating weapon meant to destroy anything it hits.

Items.Name: Scrap Hatchet
Items.Desc: A common chopping tool that has been repurposed for combat. Rapidly cycles attacks from right to left. Charge attacks strike twice.

Items.Name: Scrap Staff
Items.Desc: A staff made from old plumbing parts used for controlling wide swaths in front of the wielder.

Items.Name: Shovel
Items.Desc: It's a shovel.

Items.Name: Smolder
Items.Desc: A scorched blade imbued with FIRE.

Items.Name: Spectral Blade
Items.Desc: A super-heated laser sword with an infinitely sharp edge. Perfect for cutting... anything.

Items.Name: Steel Flail
Items.Desc: An unorthodox weapon meant to convert momentum into destruction. Some attacks can continuously chain overhead swings.

Items.Name: Steel Katana
Items.Desc: An old piece of steel with serrations cut into one side. Pipe handle provides limited grip.

Items.Name: Steel Scythe
Items.Desc: A ruthless threshing device.

Items.Name: Steel Spear
Items.Desc: A spear perfect for staying at range with quick, focused attacks. High, single-target damage.

Items.Name: Steel Sword
Items.Desc: A long, sharp blade hammered out of vehicle leaf springs. Well-rounded for most situations.

Items.Name: Stonebreaker
Items.Desc: A massive Greatsword which contains the harnessed magic of a corrupted Guardian. Can summon small shockwaves.

Items.Name: Vice Grips
Items.Desc: A N'Erudian tool converted into a ruthless ripping device. High raw damage.

Items.Name: World's Edge
Items.Desc: A glowing Greatsword forged from shards of a shattered Worldstone. Charge attacks cast waves.

Items.Name: Wrathbringer
Items.Desc: A massive hammer infused with the souls of deceased Dran. Its dormant power can be awakened by taking damage.

Items.Name: Anguish
Items.Desc: Fires heated bits of molten slag. Can be charged to fire a single explosive rod at the cost of causing damage to the wielder while charging.

Items.Name: Bolt Driver
Items.Desc: An ingenius Gul rifle designed to harness energy from Pan crystals. Charge to fire a 3-shot burst.

Items.Name: Corrupted Cube Gun
Items.Desc: Fusion charged auto-cannon generates cubes which penetrate. Infinite ammo capacity. Can overheat. Cannot score Weakspot hits.

Items.Name: Corrupted Meridian
Items.Desc: Fires rocket that deals AOE damage within 2m. Charging the weapon can load additional rockets. (Max 3). Cannot Weakspot.

Items.Name: Corrupted Nebula
Items.Desc: Semi-automatic laser weapon. Weakspot hits and kills create a Nano-bot for 8s that seeks enemies within 20m and repeatedly attacks dealing 6 → 18 ACID damage per hit. Max 5 Nano-bots.

Items.Name: Corrupted Rune Pistol
Items.Desc: A pistol infused with erroneous properties. Fires energy, allowing the trigger to be held for continuous fire.

Items.Name: Corrupted Sorrow
Items.Desc: Innately cannot harm allies. Fires bolts which anchor to targets for 6s. Max 10 bolts anchored at once.

Items.Name: Cube Gun
Items.Desc: Projectiles return on hit or after reaching max range. Reloading retrieves shot projectiles. Max 5 fired projectiles. Infinite ammo. Can overheat.

Items.Name: Double Barrel
Items.Desc: A double-barrel shotgun which can deal massive damage at close range with back to back shots.

Items.Name: Enigma
Items.Desc: Fires an electrical stream that jumps to nearby targets within 7.5m, dealing 30% reduced damage per jump. Applies OVERLOADED.

Items.Name: Hellfire
Items.Desc: Spews flames that apply BURNING which deals 300 → 900 FIRE damage over 10 seconds.

Items.Name: Meridian
Items.Desc: Fires grenades that explode on contact with enemies and deal AOE damage within 4m. Dormant grenades eventually explode and can be shot to detonate early. Cannot Weakspot.

Items.Name: MP60-R
Items.Desc: A small-caliber sub-machine gun best suited for close range skirmishes.

Items.Name: Nebula
Items.Desc: Fires a stream of superhot ACID gas which applies CORRODED effect, dealing 300 - 900 CORROSIVE Damage over 10s. Killing targets CORRODED by Nebula spawns a gas cloud which applies its on-hit effect. Gas clouds lasts 2s and can be refreshed.

Items.Name: Repair Tool
Items.Desc: Fires a stream of nanomachines, dealing damage to enemies or healing allies for 3% of their Max Health per second. The nano-tech also restores N'Erudian Energy to Turrets and Drones.

Items.Name: Redeemer
Items.Desc:
Fires a tight grouping of World Stone slugs. Hits rip away a small portion of the enemy, sending it to another realm.

Incapable of standard Mod Generation.

Items.Name: Repeater Pistol
Items.Desc: An accurate semi-automatic pistol that can rapidly fire small-caliber bullets.

Items.Name: Rune Pistol
Items.Desc: A pistol infused with mysterious Fae magic. Rapidly fires 3-round bursts of energy. Trigger can be held to continuously fire.

Items.Name: Rupture Cannon
Items.Desc: A mid-range Pistol Shotgun with a brisk fire rate and medium recoil. Slower reload.

Items.Name: Rusty Repeater
Items.Desc: An old antique pistol.

Items.Name: Service Pistol
Items.Desc: A standard issue military spec sidearm known for its reliability and accuracy.

Items.Name: Silverback Model 500
Items.Desc: A powerful hand cannon with a low capacity cylinder. High damage and a heavy kick.

Items.Name: Sorrow
Items.Desc: The last vestiges of a fallen sister, this mystical crossbow pistol has the ability to recall its bolts to heal the wielder.
Items.Where: Yaesha · Jungles of Yaesha · Dappled Glade

Items.Name: Star Shot
Items.Desc: Fires a fast moving projectile which explodes on contact. Explosion has no damage falloff.

Items.Name: Sureshot
Items.Desc: A high-caliber single-shot hunting pistol that inflicts heavy damage at mid to long range.

Items.Name: Tech 22
Items.Desc: A suppressed small-caliber automatic pistol with medium magazine capacity and a high fire rate.

Items.Name: Western Classic
Items.Desc: A classic six-shooter. Tough. Dependable.

Items.Name: Academic's Hat
Items.Desc: A soft and durable felt hat fashioned to stylize, not necessarily protect, the most important part of your body.
Items.Where: Losomn · The Great Sewers · Tiller's Rest

Items.Name: Bandit's Mask
Items.Desc: The helm of the bandit armor is a haunting symbol of the ruthless opportunism that arose after the cataclysmic destruction of Earth. Yet, for those who wear it, it also represents a means of survival in a world where mercy is a scarce commodity

Items.Name: Battle Helmet
Items.Desc: This helmet looks heavier than it is, which isn't all that surprising, considering it isn't bulletproof. Still, it's useful for protecting against falling debris, and if the angle's just right, it may get lucky and deflect a stray bullet or two. I wouldn't count on it, though.

Items.Name: Bloodless Crown
Items.Desc: The weight of this crown is heavy, so much heavier than you might have guessed. Though aged, the shining metal has been carefully preserved, and the crown jewel radiates with a passionate fury you can scarcely comprehend.

Items.Name: Bruiser Helmet
Items.Desc: The visibility in this helmet leaves much to be desired, but that's not really the point. It goes a long way in keeping your head on your shoulders.

Items.Name: Crimson Guard Shroud
Items.Desc: The hooded mask wreathes you in a vicious, fiery visage that evokes both fear and admiration. The incandescent eye slits color your vision with the hues of hellfire.

Items.Name: Crown of the Red Prince
Items.Desc: A flashy, flame-hot diadem that demands respect and attention in equal measure...were there any subjects left to offer such sentiments.

Items.Name: Cultist Hat
Items.Desc: A simple and unassuming headpiece that belies its storied past. Once worn by members of a secretive and enigmatic cult. It now serves as a symbol of redemption for those who have turned their backs on the group's teachings.

Items.Name: Dandy Topper
Items.Desc: Lovingly crafted by a skilled hatter who clearly takes great pride in their work. After being exposed to endless days of rain, the shell began to separate from the crown, so a woven cord was tied around the center to hold it in place—for now.

Items.Name: Dendroid Mask
Items.Desc: It's like putting your head inside the monsters you've been killing all this time. It's comfortable enough though, so long as you don't think about where it's been.

Items.Name: Disciple Headpiece
Items.Desc: The unwavering visage of Lydusa carves the shape of this mask. Though her sisters wandered far and wide, Lydusa seldom traveled at all, for stone by its nature is unmoving and lonely.

Items.Name: Elder Headdress
Items.Desc:
This headpiece hails from the wild and mysterious world of Yaesha. Its smooth,
    featureless. design is both eerie and elegant, painted a stark white and adorned
    with luxuriant fur and imposing horns.

Items.Name: Fae Royal Headcover
Items.Desc: It feels like you're not wearing any helmet at all - you'd swear you could even feel the wind in your hair. Yet it turns an arrow as effectively as any steel.

Items.Name: Field Medic Hat
Items.Desc: While it may shield your eyes from the sun, it's not particularly protective against the dangers of the Root.

Items.Name: Field Medic Mask
Items.Desc: This face covering protects you from contagions without obstructing your sight. You feel like a creature from another world in this thing. Perhaps that's fitting.

Items.Name: High Noon Hat
Items.Desc: Something about this hat just feels right. Paired with a bandana, it keeps the sun and elements from hindering your all-important aim.

Items.Name: Knotted Helm
Items.Desc: A hauntingly familiar visage, convincing enough to still be alive. To truly know your enemy, you must get inside its head. Literally.

Items.Name: Labyrinth Headplate
Items.Desc: This helmet is reminiscent of a statue from a time long, long before.

Items.Name: Leto Mark 1 Helmet
Items.Desc: Reinforced and designed to completely enclose the head, providing maximum protection against the dangers of the Root

Items.Name: Leto Mark II Helmet
Items.Desc: While this ironclad helmet is somewhat difficult to breathe in, you feel secure knowing even the heaviest weapon would have little chance of cracking into your skull.

Items.Name: Lodestone Crown
Items.Desc: This crown was worn by King Kolket himself. It could be heresy for a paxultek to wear such an artifact, but there are few left among the Pan who would even recognize it as their own.

Items.Name: Mudtooth's Hat
Items.Desc: A hat that once belonged to some kind of man in black. Or did it? Mudtooth went through some kind of crazy experience to get this thing, though the details are a little muddled. Either that, or he found it in a dumpster. You're going to choose to believe it's the former.

Items.Name: Nanoplated Transmitter
Items.Desc:
The wide, dish-shaped helmet functions as a long-range radar to translate the wearer's thoughts into commands for their drone.

“Cae'Loa Iturius was nominated to the Convocation on account of her innovative genius. However, she preferred the company of machines and artificial intelligence and rarely appeared in the public eye. Of the five Seekers, she was the least resistant to accepting my analysis of Alepsis-Taura.”

Items.Name: Navigator's Helm
Items.Desc: It's hard to imagine someone piloting an entire world, but that's who this helm was for. The sockets allowed them to speak with N'Erud directly. N'Erud had dozens of pilots, all working in concert-both with each other and with the world itself.

Items.Name: Nightstalker Shroud
Items.Desc: A hunting mask with advanced respirator capabilities. It purifies yet does nothing to mask the stench of death that permeates the air.

Items.Name: Radiant Visage
Items.Desc: The cowl is a striking blue, which contrasts with the large, featureless golden mask that covers the face of the wearer. This armor was highly coveted and only granted to those few who were recognized as the "Radiant Ones."

Items.Name: Realmwalker Beret
Items.Desc: This hat once belonged to Founder Ford. He was only a captain then-a much younger Ford, from a long time and many lives ago.

Items.Name: Red Widow Headdress
Items.Desc: The horns of this helmet are ornamental, designed to be displayed in addition to the Pan wearer's own horns-which themselves protrude from additional openings in the armor-to create a truly frightening visage.

Items.Name: Space Worker Mask
Items.Desc: People (Mudtooth mostly) tell stories of how, before the Root, humans could fly into space. It's probably not true, but if it were, they'd need something like this to keep them alive out there.

Items.Name: Technician Helmet
Items.Desc: An overwhelming amount of information shines within the helmet's display, the vast majority of it incomprehensible. Whether that's because it's a foreign language or the helmet has been damaged by whatever destroyed this place is anybody's guess.
Items.Where: N'Erud · The Eon Vault · Timeless Horizon

Items.Name: Trainer Cap
Items.Desc: For some reason, your head feels naked without this simple baseball cap with a fox logo. That aside, it keeps the sun out of your eyes, and that's all you ask of it.

Items.Name: True Crimson Crown
Items.Desc: Unified at long last, this enigmatic mask and flaming diadem signify that its wearer is not only forever loyal to the Red King but stands as his most favoured equal.

Items.Name: Void Skull
Items.Desc: The skull-like helm hails from the inhospitable world of Rhom, where survival demands more than just strength and cunning. Fashioned from a mysterious material, its surface glimmers with an otherworldly sheen that seems to shift and change with the light. Its sleek and angular lines, reminiscent of some alien technology, evoke a sense of unease in those who gaze upon it.

Items.Name: Zealot's Hat
Items.Desc:
A large-brimmed hat that manages to strike fear in those who see it despite its simplistic and unintimidating design. Its main use is to cast its wearer's face in
    a shadow as dark as the deeds they seek to commit under black of night.

Items.Name: Academic's Overcoat
Items.Desc: Donning this uniform makes you feel a touch smarter, and you can't help but straighten the necktie whenever it slips loose.
Items.Where: Losomn · The Great Sewers · Tiller's Rest

Items.Name: Bandit Jacket
Items.Desc: Little more than a coat, stitched together from scraps of leather and whatever else could be scavenged from the wasteland. While it may provide a small degree of protection against the elements, it's hardly suitable for combat and is more of a fashion statement than anything else.

Items.Name: Battle Shirt
Items.Desc: A simple, standard-issue army shirt made from a durable canvas composite. It's seen a lot of action but was clearly carefully maintained. There appears to be some kind of tag above the pocket, but whatever it once said, time washed it away long ago.

Items.Name: Bruiser Bodyplate
Items.Desc: This thing is difficult to put on or take off and makes you feel like a walking tank. In the thick of battle, that's exactly what you're looking for.

Items.Name: Crimson Guard Plate
Items.Desc: This heavy suit of armor encumbers your shoulders with weight befitting the burdens of a sovereign. It emits a faint heat, as if forged from an ever-hot metal.

Items.Name: Cultist Duster
Items.Desc: More symbolic than functional, it's adorned with trinkets and ornaments instead of providing significant protection. The coat's drab color blends in with the bleak, post-apocalyptic landscape, serving as a visible sign of the wearer's allegiance to the Root

Items.Name: Dendroid Chest
Items.Desc: Fibrous tentacles wrap themselves around your chest. Up until now, you've resolutely avoided this situation.

Items.Name: Disciple Mantle
Items.Desc: The pauldrons bear the mirrored faces of Meidra and Kaeula, who always journeyed together in their ethereal wanderings, for Meidra's flowers could not bloom so lovely without Kaeula's rains.

Items.Name: Elder Raiment
Items.Desc: A distinctive piece of protective gear originating from Yaesha. Its vibrant red color and fur adornments make it stand out, serving as a symbol of the wearer's status and skill. While it may not provide as much protection as some other types of armor, its lightweight construction and flexible design allow for exceptional mobility and ease of movement in combat.

Items.Name: Fae Royal Bodyplate
Items.Desc: The royal guard do not wear insignias on their chests nor crests on their shield. It is assumed their identify is clear from their grab and the confidence with which they carry themselves.

Items.Name: Field Medic Overcoat
Items.Desc: A long coat over a plate of armor. The metal could be thicker, sure, but your primary concern is safe and speedy travel to the wounded.

Items.Name: High Noon Duds
Items.Desc: A rugged amalgamation of canvas, denim, leather, and steel. These different materials all serve the same purpose of keeping you covered without inhibiting aiming mobility.

Items.Name: Knotted Cage
Items.Desc: Tightly coiled bark shrouds you like a second ribcage. Its embrace is surprisingly-and frighteningly-comforting.

Items.Name: Labyrinth Mantle
Items.Desc: Though the cloth and tassels possess a seemingly primitive design, the pure energy wracking down your spine reminds you otherwise.

Items.Name: Leto Mark 1 Armor
Items.Desc: An impressive prototype engineered to safeguard against any danger from the Root, but its cutting-edge technology sacrifices agility and mobility in exchange for unparalleled protection

Items.Name: Leto Mark II Armor
Items.Desc: A masterpiece of impenetrability. Even though quick maneuvering is near impossible in this metal behemoth, you can't help but be impressed by the ingenuity of the design and the inspired craftsmanship.

Items.Name: Nanoplated Vestments
Items.Desc:
The light-plated design of this armor protects not only flesh, but a[sic] highly advanced artificial nervous system that conducts stellar energy to power the entire suit.

“Risynth Neko's reputation as a Seeker faltered in recent cycles due to a rumor arising about his addiction to ambit ember. His reputation was not the only one damaged during the civil debates regarding N'Erud jump,[sic] but it was one of the most momentous.”

Items.Name: Nightstalker Garb
Items.Desc: This old coat is shabby, but who's really looking? The wealth of interior ammunition pockets more than makes up for it.

Items.Name: Radiant Protector
Items.Desc: A dazzling sight, its golden surface featuring a stunning sun burst pattern etched into the chest. Adorned with blue gems embedded in the shoulders this armor is fit for only the most esteemed members of the Laemir

Items.Name: Realmwalker Tunic
Items.Desc: It's not even frayed. How is that possible? Unless the World Stones did the same thing to Ford's clothes as they did to Ford himself.

Items.Name: Red Widow Raiment
Items.Desc: This chest piece must be hundreds -thousands- of years old, yet it shows no signis of rust or decay. One can only imagine a Pan king or queen wearing such  majestic regalia.

Items.Name: Space Worker Body
Items.Desc: It's made of some material you don't recognize - thick but highly pliable, did the Drzyr expect to get struck by out there?

Items.Name: Survivor Overcoat
Items.Desc: A combination of a sturdy metal chest plate and a worn, leather trench coat that provides some protection against the elements. It's clear that the are together with practicality in mind, rather than aesthetics.

Items.Name: Technician Bodyplate
Items.Desc: The Xul were engineers and builders, but this armor was made to withstand a grenade blast. Was this built for safety or something else?
Items.Where: N'Erud · The Eon Vault · Timeless Horizon

Items.Name: Trainer Clothes
Items.Desc: This isn't just any denim jacket, it's your denim jacket. It's not especial pale. 7 ready, but it's comfortable, and in it you feel ready for anything.

Items.Name: Void Carapace
Items.Desc: Crafted from the same mysterious material as the Void gloves, helm, and greaves, the chest armor completes the set's unsettling aesthetic. Its angular design is both practical and intimidating, providing unparalleled protection against the deadly environments and creatures of Rhom.

Items.Name: Zealot's Overcoat
Items.Desc: This long and tattered cloak is ideal for skulking about in the dead of night in pursuance of iniquitous aims. If you ever see the back of this cloak ahead of you, you would do well to run. If you ever see its wearer facing you, it is already too late.

Items.Name: Academic's Trousers
Items.Desc: Expensive-looking shoes fit for a lecture hall...that wouldn't last a week outside it.
Items.Where: Losomn · The Great Sewers · Tiller's Rest

Items.Name: Bandit Trousers
Items.Desc: Consists of a pair of basic slacks and sturdy boots. While it may not offer much in terms of protection, it allows for easy movement and agility in the dangerous terrain of the ruined cityscapes. The simplicity of the design is a testament to the practicality of the bandits, who prioritize functionality over aesthetics.

Items.Name: Battle Slacks
Items.Desc: A rugged pair of army pants complete with a functional, nondescript belt, a belt buckle, and a set of worn leather boots. They're designed to withstand whatver the mission demands of a soldier.

Items.Name: Bruiser Boots
Items.Desc: While they're not exactly aesthetic, you're more comfortable in twice-temper steel and repurposed tire tread than you care to admit.

Items.Name: Crimson Guard Sabatons
Items.Desc: The crimson greaves clink and clank as you walk, announcing your presence to those honored enough to know it. Each sabaton tapers to a sharp, defiant point.

Items.Name: Cultist Britches
Items.Desc: Simple slacks and boots made of cloth and wrapped in rope. Cultists rely on their unwavering devotion to the Root for their safety instead.

Items.Name: Dendroid Leggings
Items.Desc: The deadwood boots are surprisingly snug. You're not sure what you expected shodding your feet inside the bloodthirsty branches of the Root, but it wasn't this cushioned comfort.

Items.Name: Disciple Greaves
Items.Desc: You can feel all of Yaesha beneath the soles of these heavy greaves: the soft loam of the soil, the plush of green clovers, and the cold chill of a gurgling stream. You walk with the ease of those who were born of the forest.

Items.Name: Elder Leggings
Items.Desc: Designed for both form and function. Made from durable yet lightweight materials, they allow for a full range of movement and flexibility in combat.

Items.Name: Fae Royal Greaves
Items.Desc:
Although apparently made of steel, they feel lighter than any boots you've eve worn.

    No... you feel lighter when wearing them.

Items.Name: Field Medic Trousers
Items.Desc: With an assortment of pockets, pouches, and loops for your various concoctions you're essentially a walking apothecary.

Items.Name: High Noon Soles
Items.Desc: Durable pants with spurred boots and a strip of leather for a belt. The only accent is an imposing skull on the belt buckle, a constant reminder that death is always lurking in the shadows.

Items.Name: Knotted Greaves
Items.Desc: These boots are surprisingly light and agile, carrying you through foliage and bramble with ease. They seem to know where to go before you even lift you foot.

Items.Name: Labyrinth Treads
Items.Desc: The grime of a thousand different worlds mars the side of boots that walk in one place where all paths converge.

Items.Name: Leto Mark 1 Leggings
Items.Desc: Offering unparalleled protection at the cost of speed and agility. Although it hinders movement, the armor's strength allows its wearer to withstand even the most vicious attacks without fear of serious injury.

Items.Name: Leto Mark II Leggings
Items.Desc: Strong yet streamlined. Practical yet aesthetic. Although you can't expect to make a quick getaway in these, they're just what you need to stand strong against the looming threat of destruction. The care and attention to detail t| went into them is something to behold.

Items.Name: Nanoplated Waist
Items.Desc:
These boots end in a foot with three long toes, which help augment the wearer's balance and flexibility, allowing them to navigate complex and unforeseen environments.

“Maxim Lar'Veli, the People's Seeker, was nominated to the Convocation despite his relatively low status within House Al'Maruun due to his earnest nature and passionate dedication to his people. He elected himself to stay awake alongside the Seeker Primis while the rest of the Drzyr entered cryostasis. For that short while, Precept Surus and I were his only confidants.”

Items.Name: Nightstalker Pants
Items.Desc: Thin shoes that fit perfectly and feel like they practically disappear on your feet. They're ideal for stealthy maneuvering while stalking your prey.

Items.Name: Radiant Greaves
Items.Desc: Gleaming golden plates overlap and protect the wearer's feet and shins. Originally designed to be worn by the Pan, it's impressive how the armor can be adapted to fit human proportions without sacrificing its durability or protective properties.

Items.Name: Realmwalker Pantaloons
Items.Desc: There is hardly a world where these boots haven't tread.

Items.Name: Red Widow Leggings
Items.Desc: Even though this armor was designed to be worn by a Pan warrior, you are still able wear it and benefit from its protection.

Items.Name: Space Worker Legs
Items.Desc: The magnets in the boots are far stronger than those in the gloves. It's unclear how they know when to activate, but they do so on their own. Massive as N'Erud is, it must not provide enough gravity to ensure its workers remain attached to...

Items.Name: Survivor Leggings
Items.Desc: Provides minimal protection, but serve the purpose of covering up skin to prevent minor cuts and scrapes while trekking through rough terrain.

Items.Name: Technician Greaves
Items.Desc: Designed for stability rather than speed. Plant your weight in these things, and you'd be very difficult to move.
Items.Where: N'Erud · The Eon Vault · Timeless Horizon

Items.Name: Trainer Workboots
Items.Desc: Durable pants that are used to handling more than a little dirt and fur. The canteen is for your companion, while the flask is all yours.

Items.Name: Void Greaves
Items.Desc: A sturdy pair of footwear, expertly crafted from the same unknown material the other Void armor pieces. Their angular design and jagged edges give their wearer an intimidating and fearsome look. But these boots are more than fashion statement-they provided unparalleled protection and stability in the treacherous environments of Rhom.

Items.Name: Zealot's Seaboots
Items.Desc: Tall wading boots and toughened leather may protect your legs from the unruly waters of Losomn, but they will do nothing to guard against the treacherous creatures that lurk just beneath those sullied waves, thirsting for the blood of those who stray too far from shore.

Items.Name: Academic's Gloves
Items.Desc: The initials of the Dran who once owned these - and misplaced them often - are embroidered on the wool-lined inside.
Items.Where: Losomn · The Great Sewers · Tiller's Rest

Items.Name: Bandit Gloves
Items.Desc: The bandit gloves are rough, patched together from scraps of leather and cloth, a testament to their owner's resourcefulness, and willingness to do whatever it takes to survive. Despite their rough and worn appearance, the gloves provide unexpected durability and protection amidst the unforgiving ruins of the city.

Items.Name: Battle Gloves
Items.Desc: This pair of leather army gloves couldn't be more to the point. They help guard against knicks and cuts and will help you keep a strong grip even in extreme conditions. It's not the most effective gear you've ever seen, but it's better than nothing.

Items.Name: Bruiser Gloves
Items.Desc: These gauntlets are as tough as steel, as hard as stone, and up for whatever dangers or challenges come their way. They suit you well.

Items.Name: Crimson Guard Gauntlets
Items.Desc: These gauntlets line your forearms with sharp, yet elegant edges, though they lack the sharpened claws that would make a proper bloodthirsty Fae of you.

Items.Name: Cultist Gloves
Items.Desc: An unusual piece of attire that consist of leather and rope wrappings that encircle the wearer's wrists. These unconventional gloves were favored by the members of a mysterious cult that valued secrecy and esoteric knowledge above all else

Items.Name: Dendroid Grips
Items.Desc:
Against all logic, these gloves feel natural. Like extensions of who you were meant to be.

    Seems like that should bother you more.

Items.Name: Disciple Vambraces
Items.Desc: The gauntlets taper to sharp points, reminding one that everything in Yaesha is deadly, even those who seem too beautiful to be so.

Items.Name: Elder Gloves
Items.Desc: Features striking loops of gold that add an ornate touch to the otherwise plain design. Curiously, these embellishments are only present on the left-hand glove, making it stand out from its counterpart on the right.

Items.Name: Fae Royal Vambraces
Items.Desc: Suitable for archery or swordplay - for killing of any sort really.

Items.Name: Field Medic Gloves
Items.Desc: At a glance it's clear that these fingerless gloves won't keep you warm or offer much protection. Even still, you wear them because they provide improved grip without impacting precision.

Items.Name: High Noon Armguards
Items.Desc: Metal arm guards paired with well-worn gloves that are more comfortable gripping a warm gun than reaching for a handshake. They're tasked with protecting your greatest asset - your trigger finger.

Items.Name: Knotted Gloves
Items.Desc: The deadwood claws fit you almost too snug, making it difficult to remember where bark ends and your own flesh begins.

Items.Name: Labyrinth Gauntlets
Items.Desc: Craggy, uneven stone melds tightly to your hands and forearms, as if the skin of something that once was has at last found new purchase.

Items.Name: Leto Mark 1 Gloves
Items.Desc: Offering unparalleled protection against the unpredictable dangers of The Root, but the trade-off, is that they can be cumbersome and restrict dexterity, making it difficult to perform intricate tasks.

Items.Name: Leto Mark II Gloves
Items.Desc: These gauntlets are sturdy enough to hold up even against the Root: They're tough and intimidating while providing the bare-minimum level of dexterity for,a steady grip on your weapon of choice. Just don't plan on completing any tasks that require subtlety when wearing these.

Items.Name: Nanoplated Hands
Items.Desc:
These lithe vambraces taper to tightly fitted gloves made of thin, malleable metal sourced from passing asteroids caught in N'Erud's gravitational pull.

“Axion Cadyar was a high-ranking member of House Al'Maruun and the eldest of the Convocation. It was only his demoralizing temper that kept him from becoming Seeker Primis. Though he and I engaged in countless debates, he could never shake his distrust of my artificial design.”

Items.Name: Nightstalker Gloves
Items.Desc: A single glove and arm wrap are all you need or want for arm protection. The only defense you can truly rely on is a loaded gun and a clear shot.

Items.Name: Radiant Bracers
Items.Desc: The fingerless leather gloves provide exceptional dexterity to the wearer, while the vambraces are adorned with a blue gem that gives the wearer access to the volatile energy stored within.

Items.Name: Realmwalker Gloves
Items.Desc: Ford's gloves were designed for warmth and dexterity. The soldier who wore these was not swinging blades or forging metal. He was pulling triggers and throwing grenades

Items.Name: Red Widow Bracers
Items.Desc: These gloves are light, with openings for the fingers to allow the wearer maximum dexterity - a neccesary consideration for traditional Pan weaponry.

Items.Name: Space Worker Gloves
Items.Desc: Electromagnets are worked into the grip, activating automatically when the hand closes. Seems like a useful feature, so long as everything/you work with is metal.

Items.Name: Survivor Gloves
Items.Desc: Made of durable leather and include a makeshift wrist guard consisting of a metal plate secured by leather straps, providing addition protection to the wearer's wrists without sacrificing dexterity.

Items.Name: Technician Gloves
Items.Desc: A tingle runs across your palm within these gloves - like bugs skittering over your hand.
Items.Where: N'Erud · The Eon Vault · Timeless Horizon

Items.Name: Trainer Bracer
Items.Desc: An arm guard that also functions as a bite sleeve for training on the subtle nuances of when and who to bite.

Items.Name: Void Wraps
Items.Desc: Crafted from an enigmatic substance that resembles hardened bone in appearance. These gloves are a powerful tool in the hands of those who would wield the void, drawing energy from the emptiness between worlds to unleash devastating attacks. But with great power comes great cost, and those who dare to wear these gloves must be prepared to pay the price.

Items.Name: Zealot's Wraps
Items.Desc: Long gloves fit like a vice around your arms, the pressure quickening your pulse and increasing your awareness. Your hands are well protected with the exception of a few exposed fingertips, intentionally left unguarded in case a given ritual requires quick access to fresh blood.

Items.Name: A'Taerii Booster
Items.Desc: Heavy Weapons gain 10% additional damage and gain 10% additional Critical Chance in both Carry and Turret Mode.

Items.Name: Acid Stone
Items.Desc: Increases ACID damage by 15% and ACID Resistance by 20%.

Items.Name: Ahanae Crystal
Items.Desc: Deal 5% additional damage for each Status Effect the target is suffering from.

Items.Name: Akari War Band
Items.Desc: Perfect Dodges increase Critical Chance by 10% and Critical Damage by 10% for 15s.

Items.Name: Alchemy Stone
Items.Desc: Increases base Lifesteal by 6% while suffering from a negative STATUS or BLIGHT Effect.

Items.Name: Alumni Ring
Items.Desc: Increases all Elemental damage dealt by 10%.

Items.Name: Amber Moonstone
Items.Desc: When Health drops below 35%, all incoming damage is reduced by 25% and wearer becomes immune to Temporary Status Effects.

Items.Name: Anastasija's Inspiration
Items.Desc: When receiving healing effects, gain HASTE for 10s.

Items.Name: Archer's Crest
Items.Desc: Increases Projectile Speed by 20% and Decreases Weapon Charge Time by 25%.

Items.Name: Assassin's Seal
Items.Desc: Reduces enemy Awareness Range by 25%. Increases all damage dealt to enemies not targeting wearer by 10%.

Items.Name: Atonement Fold
Items.Desc: Self-inflicts BLEEDING Status upon the wearer, causing 0.275 - 0.55 BLEED damage per second. Increases Critical Chance by 5%.

Items.Desc: Ammo acquired on pickup is increased by 50% per ally also wearing this ring and is shared with other allies.

Items.Desc: Gain Infinite Stamina. All damage received is increased by 15%

Items.Desc: Forces 1% of wearer's Max Health to remain as Grey Health. Activating a skill converts 33.5% Max Health into Grey Health. Conversion cannot kill wearer.

Items.Desc: When taking fatal damage, instead of dying, the wearer's Health will drop to 1, and Movement Speed will increase by 25% for 10s. 2m cooldown.

Items.Name: Black Pawn Stamp
Items.Desc: Reduces Cooldowns of Skills by 10%.
Items.Where: Losomn · Fae Palace · Black and White

Items.Desc: Increases Reload Speed by 3% for every 20% of Magazine missing.

Items.Name: Blasting Cap Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Explosive damage by 15%.

Items.Desc: After receiving a benefit from a Relic, gain 2 Stacks of BULWARK for 30s.

Items.Name: Bloodless King's Vow
Items.Desc: Gain 4% of base Ranged Damage dealt as Lifesteal.

Items.Name: Blood Jewel
Items.Desc: Charged Melee Attacks apply BLEEDING, dealing 620 BLEED damage over 20s.

Items.Name: Blood Tinged Ring
Items.Desc: Gain 2 Health Regeneration per second when within 25m of a BLEEDING entity.

Items.Name: Booster Ring
Items.Desc: Increases all Status Resistances by 25.

Items.Name: Braided Thorns
Items.Desc: Increases Critical Chance by 10%.

Items.Name: Brawler's Pride
Items.Desc: Increases Melee Attack Speed by 15% and Melee Critical Chance by 5%.

Items.Name: Breach Accelerator
Items.Desc: Increases Movement Speed and Physical Damage by 5%. Bonus is doubled when HASTE is active.

Items.Name: Bridge Warden's Crest
Items.Desc: Perfect Dodge increases Melee Damage by 20% for 10s. Perfect Evade Flop also gains 10% Damage Reduction for the duration.

Items.Name: Burden of the Audacious
Items.Desc: Decreases all healing by 50%. Perfect Dodges heal for 25% of Max Health.

Items.Name: Burden of the Departed
Items.Desc: Reduces Total Relic Charges by 33%. Increases All Damage dealt by 10%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Destroyer
Items.Desc: Decreases Range of all Firearms by 35%. Increases all damage dealt by 15%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Divine
Items.Desc: All damage dealt by the wearer is reduced by 15%. 30% of self healing applies to allies.

Items.Name: Burden of the Excavator
Items.Desc: Explosions cannot Critical Hit. Increases Explosive Damage by 35%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Follower
Items.Desc: Reduces Fire Rate by 15%. Increases Mod Power Generation by 30%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Gambler
Items.Desc: Disables Weakspots. Increases Critical Chance by 10% and Critical Damage by 15%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Mariner
Items.Desc: Increases Skill Cooldowns by 15%. Generate 15% additional Mod Power for each Skill on Cooldown.

Items.Name: Burden of the Mason
Items.Desc: Decreases Dodge Weight Threshold by 25. Increases Melee damage by 35% of the wearer's total Damage Reduction.

Items.Name: Burden of the Mesmer
Items.Desc: Reduces Max Health by 20%. Increases All Damage by 1% for every 5% of the wearer's total Damage Reduction.

Items.Name: Burden of the Protector
Items.Desc: Reduces incoming SHIELD Duration by 50%. Increases SHIELD amount by 15%.
Items.Where: N'Erud · N'Erud Underworld · Security Drone Maze

Items.Name: Burden of the Rebel
Items.Desc: Reduces Relic Use Speed by 25%. Reduces Skill Cooldowns by 15%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Sciolist
Items.Desc: Reduces Ammo Reserves by 20%. Increases Mod and Skill Damage by 15%.

Items.Name: Burden of the Stargazer
Items.Desc: Reduces Skill Cooldowns by 15%. Activating a Skill costs 15% Health.
Items.Where: N'Erud · Towers of N'Erud · Stargazer's Tomb

Items.Name: Burden of the Warlock
Items.Desc: Reduces Mod Power Requirement by 15%. Activating a Mod costs 15% Health as Grey Health. Conversion cannot kill wearer.

Items.Name: Bypass Primer
Items.Desc: On Perfect Dodge, reload current Firearm
Items.Where: N'Erud · N'Erud Underworld · Security Drone Maze

Items.Name: Captain's Insignia
Items.Desc: Increases Revive Speed and Relic Consume Speed by 25% per downed or dead ally. Max 2 stacks.

Items.Name: Cataloger's Jewel
Items.Desc: Automatically generates 10 Mod Power per second.

Items.Name: Celerity Stone
Items.Desc: Increases Consumable and Relic Use Speed by 25%.

Items.Name: Clear Halo
Items.Desc: After 10s of not being damaged, generate a SHIELD for 10% of Max Health over 2s.

Items.Name: Closed Loop
Items.Desc: Gain 5% of Max Health as SHIELD for 10s after a Charged Shot. Accumulation resets after 10s of inaction. Max 25% SHIELD.

Items.Name: Combat Shield Generator
Items.Desc:
While in combat, Crouching or Combat Slide generates a stationary 3m x 1.5m Energy Shield with 700 Health which blocks enemy projectiles. Lasts 10s or until broken by damage.

Can only happen once every 10s after expiring.

Items.Name: Compulsion Loop
Items.Desc: After killing an enemy, gain 5% Fire Rate and Melee Attack Speed for 10s. Stacks 3x.

Items.Name: Conjurer's Circle
Items.Desc:
When the wearer's Summon enters the battlefield, conjure a 5m Summoning Circle. Allies in the Summoning Circle have their Stagger Level reduced by 1 and regenerates 5 Grey Health per second. Lasts 10s.

Can only happen once every 10s after expiring.

Items.Name: Conservation Seal
Items.Desc: For every 10% of Health missing [Max 50%], gain 10% chance to not consume Relic and 5% increased Relic Efficacy on next use.

Items.Name: Constant Variable Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Ranged damage up to 20% based on current Weapon's Overheat value.
Items.Where: N'Erud · Towers of N'Erud · Remains Below

Items.Name: Crimson Dreamstone
Items.Desc: Critical Hits increase Skill Damage by 2% for 5s. Max 10 stacks.

Items.Name: Custodian's Bastion
Items.Desc: Increases Armor by 1 per 2% of active SHIELD. Max 100 Bonus Armor.

Items.Name: Dark Sea Armada Crest
Items.Desc: On Relic Use, increases All Elemental Damage dealt by 15% for 15s.

Items.Name: Dead King's Memento
Items.Desc: Increases Health by 15.

Items.Name: Deceiver's Band
Items.Desc: After performing a Slide, gain 15% Evade Speed and 10% Movement Speed for 12s.

Items.Name: Deep Pocket Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Ammo Reserves by 35%.

Items.Name: Defensive Action Loop
Items.Desc: While reloading, and for 3s after reload completes, incoming damage is reduced by 10%.

Items.Name: Demolition Coil
Items.Desc: Unarmed Charged Melee Attacks explode when hitting an enemy, dealing 30% additional explosive damage over 1.5m.

Items.Name: Dense Silicon Ring
Items.Desc: Gain 200% of Health Regenerated as Mod Power.

Items.Name: Detonating Cord
Items.Desc: On Relic Use, increases Explosive Damage by 10% for 15s and casts a 3m Explosive AOE which deals 120 Base Damage.

Items.Name: Devoured Loop
Items.Desc: Critical Hits have a 1% chance to reset Skill Cooldowns. Can only occur once every 10s. Increases all incoming damage by 10%.

Items.Name: Digested Hog Lure
Items.Desc: Reloading increases Mod Damage by 15% for 7s.

Items.Name: Disaster Converter
Items.Desc: When wearer's Health drops below 25%, gain a SHIELD for 50% of total current Grey Health for 10s. Max 50% SHIELD. Does not stack with itself.

Items.Name: Drakestone Pearl
Items.Desc: Enables Stamina Regeneration during Melee Attacks at 20% of the normal rate.
Items.Where: Losomn · The Great Sewers · Tiller's Rest

Items.Name: Dran Memento
Items.Desc: Increases Max Stamina by 20 and reduces Encumbrance by 5.

Items.Name: Dran Scavenger Ring
Items.Desc: Collecting Scrap, Iron, and Ammo Pickups regenerates 50% of Max Health and increases all damage dealt by 8% for 30s.

Items.Name: Dread Font
Items.Desc: Increases Grey Health Regeneration rate by 2 per second.

Items.Name: Dried Clay Ring
Items.Desc: Grants 1 stack of BULWARK. Increases All Damage by 50% of the Total Damage Reduction granted by BULWARK stacks.

Items.Name: Drzyr Sniper Sigil
Items.Desc: Increases the minimum damage at Max Falloff Range from 20% to 40%.

Items.Name: Dull Steel Ring
Items.Desc: Reduces Dodge Weight Threshold by 1 Level.

Items.Name: Dying Ember
Items.Desc: Gain 6% of base Melee damage dealt as Lifesteal.

Items.Name: Elevated Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Dodge Weight Threshold by 10. Reduces Encumbrance by 10.

Items.Name: Embrace of Sha'Hala
Items.Desc: Wearer gains 7.5% incoming Damage Reduction when suffering from a unique Negative Status Effect or Blight. Max 2 stacks.

Items.Name: Empowering Loop
Items.Desc: Increases Ranged Damage by 15%. Slows Firearm Charge Time by 10% and reduces Fire Rate by 10%.

Items.Name: Encrypted Ring
Items.Desc: Using a Mod regenerates 20% of Max Health over 10s. Can stack up to 30s.

Items.Name: Endaira's Endless Loop
Items.Desc: After Sprinting for 1s, the wearer gains 2 Health Regeneration per second until they stop Sprinting.

Items.Name: Excess Coil
Items.Desc: Activating a Skill grants a SHIELD for 25% of Max Health. Cannot stack with itself. Lasts 15s.

Items.Name: Fae Bruiser Ring
Items.Desc: Dealing Melee damage grants 2 Stacks of BULWARK for 15s. Does not stack with itself.

Items.Name: Fae Hunter Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Range of Firearms by 35%.

Items.Name: Fae Protector Signet
Items.Desc: Increases Max Health and Stamina by 10 and Reduces Encumbrance by 5.

Items.Name: Fae Shaman Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Health Regeneration by 0.35 and Relic Use Speed by 25%.

Items.Name: Fae Warrior Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Melee Damage by 15%.

Items.Name: Faelin's Sigil
Items.Desc: Melee Damage generates 15% additional Mod Power.

Items.Name: Faerin's Sigil
Items.Desc: Critical and Weakspot Hits generate 12.5% additional Mod Power.

Items.Name: Feastmaster's Signet
Items.Desc: Increases active Concoction Limit by 1.

Items.Name: Feathery Binding
Items.Desc: Increases Projectile Speed by 15% and Decreases Weapon Charge Time by 10%. Bonus is doubled when HASTE is active.

Items.Name: Feedback Loop
Items.Desc: Perfect Dodge triggers a 3m AOE blast that deals 55 - 155 SHOCK Damage and applies OVERLOADED which deals 55 - 155 SHOCK damage every 5s.

Items.Name: Feeding Tube
Items.Desc:
While in combat, auto-consume the compatible item in the first quick-slot every 30s. Increases Consumable and Relic Use Speed by 10%.

Not compatible with Concoctions, Grenades and some Unique Consumables.

Items.Name: Fire Stone
Items.Desc: Increases FIRE damage by 15% and FIRE Resistance by 20.

Items.Name: Floodlit Diamond
Items.Desc: Increases Weakspot Damage by 12%. Bonus is doubled against EXPOSED targets.

Items.Name: Flyweight's Sting
Items.Desc: Increases Melee damage while Armor Encumbrance is below 50. Damage bonus increases with lower Encumbrance, up to 25% at 0 Weight.

Items.Name: Focusing Shard
Items.Desc: Aiming Down Sights gradually reduces Spread by 70% over 4s.

Items.Name: Force Multiplier
Items.Desc: Overcharging Charge Weapons grants 1.05x Weapon Damage Per 0.5s while Charge is held beyond Perfect Release Window. Max 1.3x.

Items.Name: Frivolous Band
Items.Desc: Increases Evade Speed by 10%. Perfect Evades increase Fire Rate by 10% and Melee Speed by 10% for 7s.

Items.Name: Galvanized Resupply Band
Items.Desc: Increases Ammo Pickups by 100%.

Items.Name: Game Master's Pride
Items.Desc: Reduces all healing by 50%. Splits all damage and remaining healing evenly among all allies wearing this ring.

Items.Name: Generating Band
Items.Desc: Regenerate 3% of Max Health per second while a SHIELD is active.

Items.Name: Grounding Stone
Items.Desc: Increases SHOCK damage by 15% and SHOCK Resistance by 20.

Items.Name: Guardian's Ring
Items.Desc: Adds 1 Stack of BULWARK when within 15m of an enemy. Increases to 2 Stacks for 15s after taking Melee damage.

Items.Name: Gul Signet
Items.Desc: Increases Damage Reduction by 10%. Each Weight Class above LIGHT reduces Damage Reduction bonus by 2.5% (up to 3x).

Items.Name: Gunslinger's Ring
Items.Desc: Increases Firearm Swap Speed by 30% and Reload Speed by 10%.

Items.Name: Hardcore Metal Band
Items.Desc: Taking damage adds 1 stack of BULWARK for 10s. Max 3 BULWARK stacks.

Items.Name: Hardened Coil
Items.Desc: Reduces all incoming damage by 3% for each 10% of missing Health. Max 15% reduction.

Items.Name: Haymaker's Ring
Items.Desc: Increase Melee damage by 0.2% for every 1 point of Armor Encumbrance.

Items.Name: Heart of the Wolf
Items.Desc: Increases Max Stamina by 25 and Movement Speed by 10%.

Items.Desc: Prevents CURSE.
